text:
Sam: Quick thread — ran a 1h profiling pass on prod-dedicated (model: redwood-3b) focusing on token-level TTFT vs decode kernel attribution. Found recurring spikes in 'decode' kernel time aligned with KV cache miss rate rising above ~12%. Exported samples and waveform for 2026-03-17 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Sam: TL;DR: when kv_miss_rate > 0.12 and batch_size >= 8 we see decode kernel taking 45-60% of TTFT vs baseline 20-25%. Suspect kernel_selector favoring microkernel_v1 path that is suboptimal for cold KV state.

Sam: Attached PromQL and flame snippet below; need dashboard panels per-route + per-model and per-kernel attribution. Thoughts on metricization and sampling?

Neha: oof. can you paste the promql? can we split by route tag (route=/chat.*) and by customer_tier?

Sam: PromQL: sum(rate(kernel_time_seconds_bucket{kernel=~"decode|ttft",model="redwood-3b"}[5m])) by (kernel,route) // simplified

Jia: don't use buckets for attribution. try this: sum(rate(kernel_time_seconds_sum{model="redwood-3b"}[1m])) by (kernel,route) / sum(rate(request_tokens_total{model="redwood-3b"}[1m])) by (route) -> token_ms per kernel. Also sample p50/p95.

Jia: example query: (sum(rate(kernel_time_seconds_sum{kernel="decode",model="redwood-3b"}[1m])) by (route) / sum(rate(request_tokens_total{model="redwood-3b"}[1m])) by (route)) * 1e3

Maria: can we tag kvcache hits/misses to request? we have kvcache_hit_ratio but it's per-host. need per-route kv_hits_total and kv_misses_total or a labeling of request with kv_prefetch=1.

Luca: we already export kv_prefetch and kv_lookup_latency. do we have kv_lookup_count labeled by request_id? not by default — heavy. maybe sample 1% of requests with request tracing header.

Neha: Sampling plan: enable request label tracing for 0.5% of requests on canary capacity. store trace_id -> kernel_selector_decision in tracing DB.

Sam: I dumped a small flame (attached). Key log: kernel_selector chosen=microkernel_v1 reason=latency_estimate but actual decode_time increased because cold KV caused more memory-copy. snippet:

```
[2026-03-17T02:12:33Z] kernel_selector: chosen=microkernel_v1 est=4.1ms actual=9.7ms kv_prefetch=0 batch=12
[2026-03-17T02:12:33Z] kvcache: lookup=miss latency=2.8ms keys=128
```

Jia: Sounds like estimator doesn't account for kv_miss penalty. We should include recent kv_miss_rate window into kernel cost model. Add feature kv_miss_rate_1m and weight.

Maria: dashboard suggestion: panel 1: token-level breakdown stacked bar (kernel decode, kernel ttft, queue, transfer). panel 2: kvcache miss rate overlay. panel 3: per-route p95 token latency. panel 4: time-series of kernel_selector decisions.

Sam: also need alerting: if decode_share > 0.4 for 5m AND kv_miss_rate > 0.12 trigger oncall.

Neha: agree. add playbook: roll back kernel selector to microkernel_v0 for affected routes while we tune estimator.

InfraBot: deploybot: dashboard/kernel-attribution-v2 promoted to staging at 1965432150 by Sam.

Sam: assigning owners: @Neha owner for alerts + playbook, @Jia owner for estimator change, @Maria owner for dashboard panels. I'll start a canary rollout with kv tracing 0.5%.

Luca: I'll add a sampling flag to runtime: runtime.flags.kv_trace_sampling=0.005

Neha: leaving a note — watch costs on tracing/storage. :money_with_wings: 

Jia: PR reference: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/829 (estimator kv hook).

Sam: Thanks. Can folks ack when they have 1) dashboard in staging 2) estimator PR ready 3) tracing on canary?

Neha: ack — will add alert and playbook by EOD.

Jia: ack — PR opened, tests failing but working on it.

Maria: ack — dashboard panels in staging, need review.

Luca: ack — flag added, will roll to canary.

InfraBot: alerting: new alert created decode_kv_regression (thresholds set).

Sam: great, close loop tomorrow.
